work.name: mu-zero HYPERLOOP
work.summary: Led a team of 8 members in the Electromagnetics and Cooling Department. Designed and constructed a linear induction motor (LIM) test bench. Designed a multi-part cooling reservoir mount and heat exchangers. Performed FEM (von Mises stress) analyses of mounting structures for levitation and guidance electromagnets. Maintained and tested levitation electromagnets. Developed the first fully functional cooling system for levitation electromagnets and the LIM control board. Developed a Python-based kinematic bounce simulation for the friction braking system. Contributed to subsystem integration and assembly of the Hyperloop pod.

projects.name: Understanding strain rate effects on deformation twinning in Cr-36.1Mo-3Si
projects.description: Bachelor thesis (grade 1.3, German grading system) at Institut für Angewandte Materialien. Prepared samples through sanding, polishing, and resin embedding; performed SEM-EDS X-ray spectroscopy and composition analysis; conducted compression tests at varying temperatures and strain rates; examined samples using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy; analysed stress-strain curves and SEM microstructures.
